benefits.name: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: First standard checked bag free for the primary Cardmember and one companion on the same reservation.
benefits.terms: Must purchase the ticket with the card. Applies to United- and United Express-operated flights.

benefits.name: United Club One-Time Passes
benefits.description: Two United Club one-time passes each year.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Each pass admits the cardholder; passes are one-time use.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit of up to $120 for a Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS application fee.

benefits.name: United Travel Credit
benefits.description: $100 United travel credit after spending $10,000 on purchases each year.
benefits.terms: Requires $10,000 in annual purchases to unlock.

benefits.name: United Hotels Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 annually in statement credits on prepaid hotel stays booked through United Hotels.
benefits.terms: $50 per stay, maximum two stays per year. Prepaid bookings through United Hotels only.

benefits.name: Rideshare Credit
benefits.description: Up to $60 annually in statement credits on eligible rideshare purchases, issued as $5 per month.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Up to $5 per month, $60 per year.

benefits.name: Instacart Credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 annually in Instacart statement credits, issued as $10 per month.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Benefit ends 12/31/27 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Avis and Budget Credit
benefits.description: Up to $50 annually in United travel credits on Avis or Budget rentals booked through cars.united.com.
benefits.terms: Bookings must be made through cars.united.com.

benefits.name: JSX Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 annually in statement credits on JSX flight purchases.

benefits.name: 25% Back on United Inflight Purchases
benefits.description: 25% back as a statement credit on food, beverage, and Wi-Fi purchases aboard United flights and on premium drink purchases at United Clubs.
benefits.terms: Purchases must be made with the card on United- and United Express-operated flights.

benefits.name: 10,000-Mile Award Flight Discount
benefits.description: A 10,000-mile award flight discount after spending $20,000 on purchases each calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $20,000 in purchases per calendar year.

benefits.name: Award Flight Savings
benefits.description: Save 10% or more when booking United flights with miles.

benefits.name: Priority Boarding
benefits.description: Priority boarding for the primary Cardmember and companions on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Premier Qualifying Points from Spend
benefits.description: Earn 1 PQP per $20 spent, up to 1,000 PQP per calendar year, toward Premier status.

benefits.name: Complimentary Instacart+ Membership
benefits.description: Three months of complimentary Instacart+ membership, then 25% off the annual membership rate.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Primary coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars, up to $60,000.
benefits.terms: Primary coverage. Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $1,500 per covered traveler and $6,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $500 per covered traveler for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less by an additional year.

earningRates.terms: 3x miles from the card on eligible United purchases. United flights earn 9x total when combined with the 6x earned as a MileagePlus member.
Hotel stays booked directly with the hotel.
